description: Create /docs directory with proper documentation and phased implementation plan. Includes architecture overview, v0.1 scope, API reference skeleton, getting started guide, and the phased roadmap.
steps: Create /docs/README.md as the documentation index linking to all other docs
Create /docs/architecture.md covering: high-level architecture (libkern + kern CLI + kernd), runtime model (reactor + worker pool + fibers), build pipeline, and the three deliverables

Create /docs/phase1-plan.md with detailed implementation plan for v0.1: HTTP server, radix router, file-system routing, .khtml compiler, SQLite driver, query builder, migrations, sessions, basic auth, asset hashing, kern new/dev/build. Include milestones, dependencies between components, and acceptance criteria.
Create /docs/phases-overview.md covering all phases v0.1 through v1.0 at summary level, explaining what each phase delivers and why they are ordered that way
Create /docs/api-reference.md with the public API surface for v0.1: kern.h types, request/response API, router API, template rendering, DB API, session API, config API
Create /docs/getting-started.md showing how to use kern new, kern dev, kern build once v0.1 is complete
Create /docs/project-layout.md documenting the convention-based folder structure for kern apps (pages/, views/, models/, queries/, mutations/, etc.)
Create /docs/khtml-syntax.md documenting the .khtml template language: Pug-derived syntax, interpolation, loops, conditionals, includes, extends, blocks
acceptance_criteria: /docs/ directory exists with at least 7 markdown files
docs/phase1-plan.md contains a detailed breakdown of v0.1 implementation tasks
docs/phases-overview.md covers phases v0.1 through v1.0
All docs are well-structured markdown with proper headings and code examples from the design doc
verification: Each file is valid markdown with meaningful content (not stubs)
